findings.evidence: Dark-skinned adult human man with short dark curls, a folded cream work cap with a narrow plum band, and an individual comic face.; Asymmetrical thick eyebrows, one skeptical slightly squinting eyelid, clear cheek and chin planes, and a restrained crooked half-smile; avoid the generic sad round-eyed baby face.; Preserve the compact sturdy build, plum tabard, cream sleeves, broad ochre scarf fold, short waist apron and brown boots.; Compact belt satchel with two spare corked bottles, a small ingredient pouch and simple soft work gloves.; He offers the next prepared potion upright in one hand toward his lord; the other hand retrieves supplies from his satchel.; The offered amber flask has the same absolute world size and standard bottle mold as the emperor's held green flask: equal body diameter, glass height, neck and cork; do not shrink it for the smaller squire.; Exactly two arms with a natural supporting grip, clear shoulders and elbows; no shield, no tongs and no bulky wooden bottle carrier.; Firmly planted feet and a slight compensating lean make the full-sized bottle weight readable; mirror the whole pose consistently when adapting its facing direction.

notes: Concept appearance observed; pixel-scale contact geometry remains for the native candidate.
